column1: # Translations of this plugin's content and messages (i18n plugin: key = the English text; one column per locale).
Pick a tile away from the settlement
column2: 请选择城池以外的地块
行军速度倍率（2 = 快一倍）。
单程行军的最短时间（秒）。

column1: Turn this army back? The unused provisions and everything it carries come back with it.
column2: 召回这支军队？没用上的粮饷和随军携带的物资都会带回。

column1: No armies away from home. Pick a tile on the map to send troops.
column2: 没有在外的部队。在地图上选择一个地块即可出兵。

column1: The troops unload the supplies here and come back.
column2: 部队把辎重卸在这里，然后返回。

column1: The troops go there empty and bring back what you ask for (nothing filled in = as much as they can carry).
column2: 部队空车前往，运回你填写的资源（都不填 = 能装多少运多少）。

column1: Resources can only be transported between your own settlements
column2: 只能在自己的城池之间运输

column1: Going to fetch resources, the army leaves empty
column2: 去运回资源时，部队空车出发

column1: The troops stay here if it can hold a garrison; otherwise they unload the supplies and go back.
column2: 部队留在此处驻扎；若该城池不能驻军，则卸下辎重后返回。

column1: An expedition carries the founding materials and your supplies there. The troops stay as the garrison, or come back if the new settlement cannot hold one.
column2: 筑城队带上建城材料和辎重前往。建成后部队留下驻守；若新城池不能驻军，则部队返回。

column1: That is your own settlement: transfer troops there instead
column2: 这是你自己的城池，请改用"派遣"

column1: Troops can only be transferred to your own settlements
column2: 只能派遣到自己的城池

column1: These units can carry at most {0} supplies
column2: 这些部队最多只能携带 {0} 辎重
